name: Boon
summary: Ventkids の Kubrodons のリーダー
> Boon is the leader of the Kubrodons, a subdivision of the Ventkids. He is in charge of facilitating K-Drive Races in Orb Vallis as well as stealing and salvaging K-Drive parts from the Corpus.
sections: - During Phase 3 of Profit-Taker Orb Heist, Boon provides a route for Tenno to infiltrate locked-down Enrichment Lab. He states that he has removed screws from C7A vent.
- He is voiced by Ryan Laughton.
